description:
An Accessible Introduction to Electric Riding
The HITWAY HT300 is designed for riders who want the character of an electric dirt bike in a practical, entry-level package. A 2kW motor with up to 4kW peak power provides output for everyday movement and suitable inclines. Three selectable speed settings offer additional flexibility when adapting to different riding situations. The HT300 offers an approachable way to experience motorised electric mobility. Riders must meet the relevant local age, licence, registration and insurance requirements before using it on public roads.
Practical for Mixed Urban and Leisure Routes
A typical journey may combine smooth roads, uneven streets and routes outside busy urban areas. The HT300 uses a 14-inch front wheel, 12-inch rear wheel and front and rear suspension to support riding across changing surfaces. Its dirt-bike styling gives it a distinct appearance without removing practical equipment such as rear-view mirrors. Suitable roads and permitted leisure locations should always be selected according to local vehicle regulations. The HT300 is an electric moped-style vehicle, not a conventional pedal-assisted e-bike.
Comfort and Stability on Uneven Surfaces
Uneven pavement and damaged road surfaces can affect riding comfort. Suspension at the front and rear helps absorb impacts and supports a more settled feel at appropriate speeds. The combination of suspension and pneumatic tyres is intended to work with the HT300's compact geometry. Its 77cm seat height and recommended rider height from 150cm make fit easier to assess before purchase. Riders should still ensure that they can support and manoeuvre a 49.1kg motorised vehicle safely.
Hydraulic Brakes for Controlled Riding
The HT300 has hydraulic disc brakes at both wheels, allowing riders to regulate braking effort progressively. This is especially useful when moving between different road surfaces or approaching junctions. Clear braking response supports a considered riding style, while appropriate tyre grip and speed remain essential. On wet streets or loose surfaces, stopping distances may increase. The braking system is one part of safe vehicle control, alongside rider experience, protective equipment and regular maintenance.
Battery Capacity and Ownership Value
The 48V 27Ah lithium-ion battery offers 1,296Wh of capacity for planned daily and leisure use. Stated range is 45–60km, while charging takes approximately six hours. This helps owners estimate when they should recharge and how to plan their next ride. Mirrors, a steering lock and COC documentation contribute to the practical ownership package. The HT300 brings together electric dirt-bike styling, braking control, suspension and battery capacity without positioning itself as a high-end competition motorcycle.
